notes: Targets is much more useful. The table now shows how often the round is won after each player dies first or gets the opening kill, their average first-death time, and counts like 3/4 next to every percentage, sorted easiest-to-target first, with a team summary line. Three charts were added in the app and the prep deck: a timeline of opening deaths and kills, a line/area chart of opening deaths over time, and win-rate bars. Prep decks now have a Targets slide right under each site's Players slide, plus a charts slide per map and side. Restart the app after updating.
